description: "The Relations of Science and Religion" by Henry Calderwood is a scholarly work that examines the intersection between scientific and religious thought, likely written in the late 19th century. In this treatise, Calderwood aims to explore the compatibility and potential harmony between the findings of modern science and the tenets of Christianity, particularly those as articulated in the Bible.
